title: The UPI request
premise: Daughter asks Mummy for 500 rupees for 'books'; Mummy says she'll send it, then notes the exact amount matches the concert ticket she saw in her Bookmyshow email on the shared tablet.

script.text: Beta, need anything for this month.
mumma can u send 1500 for books
Tell the books I said enjoy the concert on Saturday.

caption: books cost 1500
